designationHistory.name: Baaj Nwaavjo I'tah Kukveni--Ancestral Footprints of the Grand Canyon National Monument
designationHistory.indexText: President Biden established the Baaj Nwaavjo I'tah Kukveni--Ancestral Footprints of the Grand Canyon National Monument by proclamation under the Antiquities Act.
designationHistory.note: Proclamation reserves about 917,618 acres; BLM page says BLM administers 529,242 acres and the Forest Service 388,376. Published in the Federal Register Aug. 15, 2023. Name field gives the proclamation's full title.

sources.name: 54 U.S.C. 320301 notes, national monuments list (Cornell LII)
